symptoms: Narrow reddish-brown streaks appear on leaves.
Severely affected areas turn brown and dry.
source_text: Black Sigatoka is affecting banana leaves in the lower canopy. Early symptoms appear as narrow reddish-brown streaks that lengthen and darken; severely affected areas turn brown and dry. The disease is active in the planting during the current wet period, and new lesions are appearing on additional leaves.
occurrence_status: Active during the current wet period, with new lesions appearing on additional leaves.
